comment: The draft warns that "a maximalist global model… will not be adopted," but does not state the positive rule. We recommend adding it: keeping the shared core minimal, and reaching through governed national/local extension. A minimal core is what enables the extensibility the draft wants; the maturity spectrum can reference it.

reviewer.organisation: CoWEAVE - Medtronic LABS; eGov Foundation; Open Healthcare Network Foundation

public.text: The draft warns that "a maximalist global model… will not be adopted," but does not state the positive rule. We recommend adding it: keeping the shared core minimal, and reaching through governed national/local extension. A minimal core is what enables the extensibility the draft wants; the maturity spectrum can reference it.
